name: telegram-send
description: Send one local file, or a short text message, to the configured Telegram group through dev-cli, with the content checked first (file: exists, size, not a credential file; text: empty, 4096 characters, no token or password) and the bot token never printed. Skill `send` for the normal path; agent `telegram-sender` runs the same send on the cheapest model when the main conversation should not spend tokens on it.
